findings_to_judge.finding: Meta's own Q2 2026 release (2026-07-29, 57 days after ODDITY last guided) shows average price per ad +12% y/y -- identical to Q1 2026 -- with ad impressions growth decelerating from +19% to +14%, i.e. the auction ODDITY blames for its CPA blow-up is still inflating at an unchanged rate while inventory growth slows; ODDITY's whole Q2/H2 case rests on its 'largest advertising partner' delivering an estimated 40-60% CPA recovery through system fixes.

On 2026-09-03 a single line -- the October 16 2026 $7.50 put -- printed 24,001 contracts, 99.9% of the day's total ODD options volume and 2.8x the entire pre-existing open interest of 8,509, at a strike 48.4% below the then-spot of $14.54; on the same day the 3-month 90/110 skew FELL 4.76 percentage points to 0.73, which is the direction skew moves when size is sold to dealers, not bought.

The sealed baseline's eight-print history is wrong and only two of the eight 6-Ks are earnings: 2026-08-21 is the appointment of director David S. Cohen, 2026-07-30 is the AGM voting results, 2026-06-12/06-16 are the AGM proxy statement and proxy card, and 2026-03-12 is the $200m buyback authorisation -- leaving 2026-02-25 (-49.21%) and 2026-06-02 (-29.61%) as the only real earnings reactions, both of which are larger in absolute terms than the 20.7% currently implied.

ODDITY has pushed both 2026 interim reports roughly five weeks later than the prior year -- Q1 from 2025-04-29 to 2026-06-02 (+34 days) and Q2 from 2025-08-04 to 2026-09-09 (+36 days) -- while leaving the Q4/FY date untouched at February 25 in both 2025 and 2026, and has switched from after-close release with a next-morning call to a same-morning pre-open release.

IL MAKIAGE's own web traffic -- whose single largest channel is Display advertising at 28.84% of desktop visits, i.e. a direct read on the paid-acquisition funnel management says it is re-scaling -- kept falling sequentially all summer: 2.44M visits in June 2026, 2.36M in July (-3.18%), ~2.3M in August (-4.73%), with the site's global rank sliding from ~10,747 to ~15,447 over three months.
